svg.title: The lifecycle is fixed. The shape is your choice.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The lifecycle is fixed. The shape is your choice.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing the socket lifecycle as a ladder of server calls socket, bind, listen and accept beside the client's socket and connect, with the three-way handshake marked as happening inside connect and accept returning a brand new socket; a byte stream drawn as alternating four-byte length tags and messages with red cut marks at every boundary and a crossed-out claim that one recv equals one message; and three panels comparing a thread-per-connection server at 1002 threads and 35.7 KiB per connection, a select loop at 2 threads and 0.9 KiB, and asyncio at 2 threads and 6.0 KiB, with measured p99 latencies of 180.7, 79.7 and 266.7 microseconds.
svg.text: The lifecycle is fixed. The shape is your choice.
draw it from memory, then compare
